if start is None:

    req_mins = None

import re
from datetime import datetime

# --- Login tokens ---
sp_access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='eri_powe@gmail.com', password=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']
sn_access_token = apis.simple_note.login(username='eri_powe@gmail.com', password=[p['password'] for p in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if p['account_name']=='simple_note'][0])['access_token']

# --- Get today's required duration from Simple Note ---
note = apis.simple_note.show_note(access_token=sn_access_token, note_id=836)
content = note['content']

now = datetime.now()
day_names=['monday','tuesday','wednesday','thursday','friday','saturday','sunday']
today_day = day_names[now.weekday()]

lines = content.splitlines()
start=None
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if re.match(r'^day:\s*'+re.escape(today_day)+r'\s*$', l.strip()):
        start=i
        break

req_mins=None
if start is not None:
    end=None
    for j in range(start+1, len(lines)):
        if re.match(r'^day:\s*\w+\s*$', lines[j].strip()):
            end=j
            break
    block = lines[start:end] if end is not None else lines[start:]
    for b in block:
        m = re.match(r'^duration_mins:\s*(\d+)', b.strip())
        if m:
            req_mins=int(m.group(1))
            break

required_seconds = req_mins*60
print('today_day', today_day)
print('required_mins', req_mins)
print('required_seconds', required_seconds)

# --- Candidate playlists from library by keywords ---
terms = ['workout','gym','fitness','cardio','run','training','hiit']
unique = {}  # playlist_id -> title

for term in terms:
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=sp_access_token, query=term, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-created_at')
        if not page:
            break
        for pl in page:
            unique.setdefault(pl['playlist_id'], pl['title'])
        if len(page) < page_limit:
            break
        page_index += 1

print('candidate_playlist_count', len(unique))
print('candidate_playlists', sorted([(pid,title) for pid,title in unique.items()], key=lambda x:x[0]))

# --- Score by total duration ---
qualified=[]
for pid,title in unique.items():
    pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=sp_access_token)
    songs = pl.get('songs', [])
    total_seconds = sum(int(s.get('duration',0)) for s in songs)
    qualified_flag = total_seconds >= required_seconds
    print('playlist', pid, title, 'songs', len(songs), 'total_seconds', total_seconds, 'meets', qualified_flag)
    if qualified_flag:
        qualified.append((total_seconds, len(songs), pid, title))

print('qualified_count', len(qualified))
qualified_sorted = sorted(qualified, key=lambda x: (-x[0], -x[1], x[2]))
print('top_qualified', qualified_sorted[:5])

best = qualified_sorted[0] if qualified_sorted else None
if best is None:
    print('No qualified playlist found. Will fall back to longest playlist overall among candidates.')
    longest=[]
    for pid,title in unique.items():
        pl = apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=sp_access_token)
        songs = pl.get('songs', [])
        total_seconds = sum(int(s.get('duration',0)) for s in songs)
        longest.append((total_seconds,len(songs),pid,title))
    longest_sorted = sorted(longest, key=lambda x:(-x[0],-x[1],x[2]))
    best = longest_sorted[0]

best_total_seconds, best_song_count, best_playlist_id, best_title = best
print('best_playlist_id', best_playlist_id)
print('best_playlist_title', best_title)
print('best_total_seconds', best_total_seconds)
print('best_song_count', best_song_count)
